Types of shooting games

There are 6 main types of shooting games that you can play on Poki.

FPS games

FPS games put you right in the action through your character's eyes. You move, aim and shoot at the same time while reacting to enemies around you. Matches have objectives like capture the flag or team death-matches that determine who will win.

Top games: Combat Online 2, Cryzen.io

Wave survival shooters

Enemies keep coming in waves, getting faster or stronger each round. You'll earn new weapons or boosts like faster shooting or stronger damage as you play. Use them to survive longer and beat your best run. If you slow down even for a second, the enemies will take you out.

Top games: Funny Shooter 2, Zombie Rush

Puzzle shooters

Instead of shooting quickly, you take your time to think about where each shot will land. Often these games are turn-based, so every shot counts. Clear levels using fewer moves to get a better score.

Top games: Raft Wars, Mr Bullet

Archery games

Aim your bow carefully, adjusting higher or lower depending on the distance before you shoot. You won't be firing quickly, so every arrow needs to land cleanly.

Top games: Narrow.One, Archery World Tour

Arcade shooters

Jump straight into quick matches with basic controls and non-stop movement. These games cover a wide range of shooting games from shoot 'em ups and shooting platform games, to arena-style 1v1 games.

Top games: Getaway Shootout, Rooftop Snipers

Sniper games

In sniper games, you need to slow down and wait for the right moment to shoot. Take your time and line up each shot carefully to take out your target, or multiple targets, in one go.

Top games: The Sniper Code, Lethal Sniper 3D: Army Soldier

games.description:
About Subway Surfers
Runs start slow, then fill the screen with obstacles in seconds. One clean dodge becomes two, then three in a row as the game speeds up.
You're reacting before you can see what's coming next. One late move ends the run, and you're straight back in trying to beat your last score.
With over 17 million player upvotes, Subway Surfers is one of the most played games at Poki.
Latest Subway Surfers World
The latest Subway Surfers world takes you to the tropical Bali. Dash through lush jungle paths, race past vibrant temples, and soak in the colorful island vibes. Ready to explore paradise?
Subway Surfer characters
There are 9 main characters to play as in Subway Surfers. You start the game as Jake, the original Subway Surfer, and soon unlock Tricky.
As you keep playing, more characters become available by spending coins. While these characters don't have any special abilities, they
Here's how much you will need to get each character.
CharacterPriceTricky3 🪙Yutani500 🪙Lucy7,000 🪙Tagbot12,000 🪙Ninja20,000 🪙Tasha30,000 🪙King80,000 🪙Brody350,000 🪙
Subway Surfers gameplay
Subway Surfers never stops moving forward. Around half a minute in, the speed jumps and obstacles start coming at you faster.
One slow swipe and you slam into a train. It feels like you missed surviving by a split second, which is what makes you hit restart before you even think about giving up.
Controls
Subway Surfers uses simple controls that let you react quickly on both desktop and mobile.
Knowing the controls is the difference between a high score and an instant crash.
Here are the controls for both:
Desktop:

Left/right arrow: Move left/right
Up arrow: Jump
Down arrow: Roll
Space: Activate hoverboard

Mobile:

Swipe left/right: Move left/right
Swipe up: Jump
Swipe down: Roll
Double tap: Activate hoverboard

Subway Surfers items
There are 5 main types of items in Subway Surfers. Coins and keys unlock upgrades, while power ups, boosters and hoverboards help you survive longer.
Coins and keys
Coins and keys are the two in-game currencies that you collect as you play the game.

Coins: This is the main currency that you can use to buy characters, hoverboards, power ups and boosters in the game. They line the tracks and pull you into tight lanes and late dodges. Going for more coins often means taking one extra dodge that ends the run.
Keys: These are rarer than coins. Get them by unlocking awards or by opening Mystery Boxes. The blue keys are used to upgrade your hoverboards' special powers or to unlock new skins for your characters.

Power ups
There are 4 main power ups in Subway Surfers. Power ups give you short bursts of control when the run starts getting harder.
These can be upgraded in the shop to help you survive longer runs.

Spray Can Jetpack: Launches you above the chaos so you can ignore obstacles completely for a few seconds.
Super Sneakers: Gain a temporary jump boost that lets you clear obstacles easier and reach hidden areas.
Coin Magnet: Automatically collect all coins around you as you run through the level
2x Score Multiplier: Doubles your current score multiplier temporarily so you can get a higher score easier.

Boosters
There are 3 boosters that you can purchase or win from Mystery Boxes. These are single-use items that help you survive mistakes and beat your high score.

Hoverboards: Hoverboards save you from one crash and keep the run alive.
Score Booster: This blue star adds +5 to your current score multiplier.
Headstart: Fly past the start of the level, allowing you to skip a portion of the run.

Hoverboards
Hoverboards give you one extra crash. When a bad landing would normally end the run, the hoverboard breaks instead and lets you keep going.
Apart from the starting hoverboard, there are 15 hoverboards in Subway Surfers to unlock, each with its own special powers.
Here is what hoverboard special powers do:

Double Jump: Jump a second time when you're in the air.
Stay Low: Roll under low obstacles automatically.
Super Jump: Boosts your normal jump so you can jump higher.
Smooth Drift: Fall slower after you jump.
Speed Up: Increases your speed slightly by 12.5%.
Zap Sideways: Change lanes instantly to avoid obstacles.

Below you will see the hoverboards available, their powers and prices. Many of the hoverboards will have the special powers locked. To unlock them, you will need to buy them with keys.

Mystery Boxes
Collecting Mystery Boxes gives you one of 8 possible prizes. With useful boosts and rare jackpots, one good Mystery Box pull can turn a bad run into your best one.
These can be found during runs, can be bought from the shop or are given as rewards for completing the Word Hunt missions.
The prizes are:

Special: Headstarts, up to 10 Hoverboards or up to 2500 coins
Rare: Keys, Score Boosters, Trophies or 5000 coins
Jackpot: 100,000 coins!

Subway Surfers missions and awards
Every mission and award pushes you to make risky moves and survive a little longer so you can unlock better upgrades and items.

Word Hunt: Here you can see how far along the daily Word Hunt challenge you are. Every day, you must collect the letters S U R F E R while playing the game to unlock daily prizes. By completing this 5 days in a row you will get a Super Mystery Box.
Missions: Missions push you into risky moves, rewarding you with permanent score multipliers. Chasing missions like rolling 30 times or getting 2000 coins from Mystery Boxes push you to keep playing and going further.
Spraycan Awards: There are 12 awards, each with four tiers that reward you with keys. Bronze gives 3 keys, silver gives 5 keys, gold gives 8 keys and diamond gives 10 keys.

Who created Subway Surfers?
Subway Surfers was created by SYBO Games, a studio based in Denmark.
First released in 2012, it quickly became one of the most played endless runners online, reaching over 1.8 billion downloads by 2021.
The game has been playable on Poki since 2018, bringing the same fast-paced experience straight to the browser.

The Subway Surfers app is available to download on mobile for both Android and iOS.

Physics-based games

Forget precision combos, Ragdoll mechanics turn every fight into controlled chaos. Your character flops around like a ragdoll, and landing a clean hit is half luck, half timing. Check out Gladihoppers, Ragdoll Hit and Stickman Fight: Ragdoll if these games interest you.

Types of puzzle games

There are 6 main types of puzzle games you can play on Poki. Some games are about matching fast, while others make you think through every move.

Matching puzzles

Line up colors, shapes or symbols to clear space and keep the board under control. Many of these are match 3 games, where you match at least 3 pieces to clear them. One well-placed move can trigger a chain reaction, clearing several more pieces automatically.

Top games: Bubble Shooter, Spectrum, Shenzhen Mahjong

Logic puzzles

Logic puzzles games give you a fixed set of rules or clues and one correct answer to find. You test one idea at a time, rule out the options that don't work and narrow it down until only one solution fits. These games reward working through problems step by step over reacting quickly.

Top games: Brain Test: Tricky Puzzles, Not Not, Logic Master

Movement and block puzzles

Move pieces around the board to open paths or clear space without trapping yourself. Some use falling blocks like Tetris-style games, where careful placement keeps the board from filling up. In others, like jigsaw puzzle games, you fit pieces together to complete the picture.

Top games: Blocky Blast Puzzle, Blocky Out, Jigsaw Surprise

Merge puzzles

Merge 2 matching pieces to create a higher-value one, then keep merging to reach a target tile or score. The challenge is managing board space: if every spot fills up, the game ends. In 2048, you merge numbers together with the goal of building up to the 2048 tile.

Top games: 2048, Merge Rot, Watermelon Drop

Word puzzles

Word puzzles test your ability to find or figure out hidden words using letters and patterns. In games like Word Chains and Word Boss, you find as many words as you can from a set of letters before options run out. In Hangman, you guess one letter at a time, with each correct guess revealing more of the hidden word.

Top games: Hangman, Word Chains, Word Boss

Number puzzles

Place numbers into the correct spots while following strict rules. Every number affects the rest of the board, so one wrong number can break the whole board and force you to rethink everything. In Sudoku, for example, each row, column and 3×3 grid must contain numbers 1-9 once.

Top games: Sudoku, Numbers

Subway Surfers items
There are 5 main types of items in Subway Surfers. Coins and keys unlock upgrades, while power ups, boosters and hoverboards help you survive longer.
Coins and keys
Coins and keys are the two in-game currencies that you collect as you play the game.

Coins: This is the main currency that you can use to buy characters, hoverboards, power ups and boosters in the game. They line the tracks and pull you into tight lanes and late dodges. Going for more coins often means taking one extra dodge that ends the run.
Keys: These are rarer than coins. Get them by unlocking awards or by opening Mystery Boxes. The blue keys are used to upgrade your hoverboards' special powers or to unlock new skins for your characters.

Power ups
There are 4 main power ups in Subway Surfers. Power ups give you short bursts of control when the run starts getting harder.
These can be upgraded in the shop to help you survive longer runs.

Spray Can Jetpack: Launches you above the chaos so you can ignore obstacles completely for a few seconds.
Super Sneakers: Gain a temporary jump boost that lets you clear obstacles easier and reach hidden areas.
Coin Magnet: Automatically collect all coins around you as you run through the level
2x Score Multiplier: Doubles your current score multiplier temporarily so you can get a higher score easier.

Boosters
There are 3 boosters that you can purchase or win from Mystery Boxes. These are single-use items that help you survive mistakes and beat your high score.

Hoverboards: Hoverboards save you from one crash and keep the run alive.
Score Booster: This blue star adds +5 to your current score multiplier.
Headstart: Fly past the start of the level, allowing you to skip a portion of the run.

Hoverboards
Hoverboards give you one extra crash. When a bad landing would normally end the run, the hoverboard breaks instead and lets you keep going.
Apart from the starting hoverboard, there are 15 hoverboards in Subway Surfers to unlock, each with its own special powers.
Here is what hoverboard special powers do:

Double Jump: Jump a second time when you're in the air.
Stay Low: Roll under low obstacles automatically.
Super Jump: Boosts your normal jump so you can jump higher.
Smooth Drift: Fall slower after you jump.
Speed Up: Increases your speed slightly by 12.5%.

Mystery Boxes
Collecting Mystery Boxes gives you one of 8 possible prizes. With useful boosts and rare jackpots, one good Mystery Box pull can turn a bad run into your best one.
These can be found during runs, can be bought from the shop or are given as rewards for completing the Word Hunt missions.
The prizes are:

Special: Headstarts, up to 10 Hoverboards or up to 2500 coins
Rare: Keys, Score Boosters, Trophies or 5000 coins
Jackpot: 100,000 coins!

Subway Surfers missions and awards
Every mission and award pushes you to make risky moves and survive a little longer so you can unlock better upgrades and items.

Word Hunt: Here you can see how far along the daily Word Hunt challenge you are. Every day, you must collect the letters S U R F E R while playing the game to unlock daily prizes. By completing this 5 days in a row you will get a Super Mystery Box.
Missions: Missions push you into risky moves, rewarding you with permanent score multipliers. Chasing missions like rolling 30 times or getting 2000 coins from Mystery Boxes push you to keep playing and going further.
Spraycan Awards: There are 12 awards, each with four tiers that reward you with keys. Bronze gives 3 keys, silver gives 5 keys, gold gives 8 keys and diamond gives 10 keys.

Who created Subway Surfers?
Subway Surfers was created by SYBO Games, a studio based in Denmark.
First released in 2012, it quickly became one of the most played endless runners online, reaching over 1.8 billion downloads by 2021.
The game has been playable on Poki since 2018, bringing the same fast-paced experience straight to the browser.
